home.title: Connect 4 Solver — Perfect Play & Move Analysis
home.description: Play Connect 4 against a perfect mathematical solver. Analyze every move, find the optimal strategy, and review game recaps. Runs entirely in your browser via WebAssembly.

win.label: a winning move
win.hint: You can complete four in a row right now — take it.

block.label: a block
block.hint: Your opponent threatens four in a row next turn — the red line shows it. Take that square to deny it.

odd_threat.label: an odd threat
odd_threat.hint: This sets up a winning square on an odd row. Odd threats are the first mover’s weapon — they decide the endgame zugzwang.

even_threat.label: an even threat
even_threat.hint: This sets up a winning square on an even row. Even threats are the second mover’s weapon — the basis of the claimeven strategy.

claimeven.label: a claimeven
claimeven.hint: You took an even square (row 2, 4, or 6) directly above your opponent’s. As the second player, the even squares are your territory — for every square they take below, you can take the one above. This claimeven is the backbone of the second player’s defence.

develop.label: a developing move
develop.hint: No immediate threat yet — this is the strongest building move. Watch the marked squares for where threats are forming.

headline.win: ✓ First player can force the win
headline.winBlack: ✓ Second player can force the win
headline.draw: ✓ Second player can hold at least a draw

anchor.oddThreat: The odd threat at {sq} hands you the zugzwang — the win flows from it.
anchor.immediate: You can complete four right now in column {col}.
anchor.aftereven: The even squares at {sq} are yours — you complete four there and win.
anchor.combination: The double threat at {a}/{b} forces an odd threat whichever way they reply.

rule.claimeven: Claimeven — claim the even square above theirs
rule.baseinverse: Baseinverse — two playable squares, they can’t get both
rule.vertical: Vertical — answer on top to deny the column
rule.aftereven: Aftereven — even squares kill the threats above
rule.lowinverse: Lowinverse — two odd squares, you get one
rule.highinverse: Highinverse — control three-high in two columns
rule.baseclaim: Baseclaim — a claim plus an inverse on the base row
rule.before: Before — answer above to win before they connect

pairing.covers: These rules answer every one of the opponent’s {n} potential fours.

header.title: Customization

header.tagline: Toggle workspace elements to build your perfect Connect 4 interface.

aside_order.title: Sidebar Order
aside_order.desc: Drag items or use the arrows to change the layout order of sidebar components.

steady.title: Steady-State Diagram in Learn mode
steady.desc: Solver mode always shows the small diagram. In Learn mode, choose where (if anywhere) it appears: the small aside card, the glyphs on the main board, or both. "Off" keeps the progressive hints.

hideLearn.label: Hide Learn mode card
hideLearn.desc: Removes the Learn-mode card and its hints. Hide it while in Learn mode for a true no-help board.

hideSteadyState.label: Hide Steady-State Diagram
hideSteadyState.desc: Removes the Steady-State Diagram from every mode. When off, it always shows in Solver mode.

hideHeader.label: Hide website header
hideHeader.desc: Removes the top logo, title, and follow suggestions tagline.

hideMoveSequence.label: Hide move sequence list
hideMoveSequence.desc: Removes the played column numbers log and the individual move scores.

hideAutoplay.label: Hide autoplayer buttons
hideAutoplay.desc: Removes the individual "Auto" and global "Auto both" click options.

hideEvalBar.label: Hide evaluation bar/badges
hideEvalBar.desc: Hides the main horizontal board-balance graph and individual P1/P2 evaluation totals.

hideNavigation.label: Hide navigation controls
hideNavigation.desc: Hides the "Back", "Forward" and "Latest" game evaluation and step buttons.

hideExportImport.label: Hide Export & Import recap
hideExportImport.desc: Hides the modal preview, copy text, resignation triggers, and column loader.

hideColors.label: Hide color editor & presets
hideColors.desc: Hides swatches, preset database, custom Hex values inputs, and quick swap button.

hideSolverStatus.label: Hide WASM solver status
hideSolverStatus.desc: Removes the running WebAssembly compiler and opening book diagnostic card.

hideFooter.label: Hide website footer
hideFooter.desc: Removes citation details, licensing, and GitHub link sections from the bottom.

hideScoreBar.label: Hide solver score bar
hideScoreBar.desc: Removes the solver score row (+/−) displayed above the column headers.

hideColumnHelp.label: Hide column suggestion highlights
hideColumnHelp.desc: Stops highlighting which column the solver recommends above the board.

hideLangSelector.label: Hide language selector
hideLangSelector.desc: Hides the EN/FR/DE language switcher independently of the footer.

lockPredictions.label: Lock predictive moves
lockPredictions.desc: Turns the "wins in" status into plain text so predictive future moves can no longer be revealed by tapping it.
